blocks.x: Operators describe the change as boring, in the best sense: the platform handles the recoverable failures by policy, pages humans only on user impact, and every intervention is logged into the evidence trail automatically.

Qiskit, PennyLane, Gurobi/CP-SAT, Slurm, CUDA, CBOM tooling — integrated through versioned contracts. Adapters to core systems (CRM, ERP, core banking, EHR, WMS/MES, SCADA) are maintained like products: schema changes are tested against consumer suites before release, and one contract update propagates to every human or agent consumer.
